unresolved_items: aiohttp route-matching semantics for web.get('/{tail:[a-z0-9.]*}', ...): whether the router matches the raw (percent-encoded) path with an anchored whole-path pattern, which would constrain request.path[1:] to [a-z0-9.] characters (no '/', no '\\', no '%..%' sequences) and make the S05->K11/K12 flow non-exploitable in the deployed aiohttp version. aiohttp is not part of the CodeQL database, so this cannot be resolved from DB code; an attempt to inspect a locally downloaded aiohttp wheel was blocked by tool-availability issues during the run. Recorded as the primary manual-review point (phase1_review.md item R1). The source/sink labels themselves are unaffected: request.path is an attacker-influenced boundary and open(:264)/FileResponse(:265) are genuine file APIs regardless of the router constraint.
